qa_pairs.interviewer_question: Describe the concept of RESTful APIs.
qa_pairs.candidate_answer: REST is an architectural style for distributed systems. It uses HTTP methods (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE) to perform CRUD operations on resources identified by URLs. RESTful APIs are stateless, cacheable, and use standard status codes. I hope that answers your question.
